examples.text: ayoge yuñjam'attānaṃ, yogasmiñ'ca ayojayaṃ, atthaṃ hitvā piyaggāhī, pihet'att'ānuyoginaṃ.

8783.grammar: masc, from na yojeti, neg, caus

examples.text: yogā ve jāyatī bhūri, ayogā bhūrisaṅkhayo, etaṃ dvedhāpathaṃ ñatvā, bhavāya vibhavāya ca, tath'āttānaṃ niveseyya, yathā bhūri pavaḍḍhati.

8784.commentary: (MNa) ayogakkhemakāmo'ti catūhi yogehi khemaṃ nibbhayaṭṭhānaṃ anicchanto bhayam'eva icchanto.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso yamaka, gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo, so ca ārakkhasampanno. tassa koci'd'eva puriso uppajjeyya anatthakāmo ahitakāmo ayogakkhemakāmo jīvitā voropetu'kāmo.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, araññe pavane mahantaṃ ninnaṃ pallalaṃ. tam'enaṃ mahāmigasaṅgho upanissāya vihareyya. tassa koci'd'eva puriso uppajjeyya anatthakāmo ahitakāmo ayogakkhemakāmo.

8785.meaning1: not free from bondage; not secure from bondage

examples.text: te yogayuttā mārassa, ayogakkhemino janā, sattā gacchanti saṃsāraṃ, jātimaraṇagāmino.

iti kāmayogo bhavayogo diṭṭhiyogo avijjāyogo, saṃyutto pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi saṃkilesikehi ponobhavikehi sadarehi dukkhavipākehi āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇikehi. tasmā ayogakkhemī'ti vuccati. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro yogā.
yo taṃ tathā pajānāti, yathā buddhena desitaṃ, na gaṇhāti bhavaṃ kiñci, sutattaṃ'va ayoguḷaṃ.
seyyo ayoguḷo bhutto, tatto aggisikh'ūpamo, yañ'ce bhuñjeyya dussīlo, raṭṭhapiṇḍam'asaññato.

8789.meaning2: Chapter 3 of the Iddhipādasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

8791.commentary: (UDa) gāthāsu pana ayoghanahatassā'ti ayo haññati etenā'ti ayoghanaṃ, kammārānaṃ ayokūṭaṃ ayomuṭṭhi ca. tena ayoghanena hatassa pahatassa. keci pana ayoghanahatassā'ti ghanaayopiṇḍaṃ hatassā'ti atthaṃ vadanti.

examples.text: ayoghanahatass'eva, jalato jātavedaso, anupubb'ūpasantassa, yathā na ñāyate gati.

8793.grammar: prp of na yojayati, neg, caus, intrans (+loc)
8793.meaning1: not joining; not engaging; not participating (in)

examples.text: ayoge yuñjam'attānaṃ, yogasmiñ'ca ayojayaṃ, atthaṃ hitvā piyaggāhī, pihet'att'ānuyoginaṃ.

8794.commentary: (MNa) ayojjhan'ti vādayuddhena yujjhitvā cāletuṃ asakkuṇeyyaṃ acalaṃ nikkampaṃ thiraṃ.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho pañcak'aṅgaṃ thapatiṃ uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamuṇḍikāputto etadavoca, catūhi kho ahaṃ, gahapati, dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññapemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ.

8795.construction:
na > a + √yudh > yodh + *ya + ā
ayojjha + ā
8795.commentary: (SNt) kenaci kāraṇena yujjhitvā gahetuṃ na sakkā'ti ayujjhā nāma.

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā ayojjhāyaṃ viharati gaṅgāya nadiyā tīre.

8797.meaning1: not a valid way (to); incorrect method (for)

examples.text: ayoni h'esā, bhūmija, phalassa adhigamāya.
ayoni suddhim'anvesaṃ, aggiṃ paricariṃ vane, suddhimaggaṃ ajānanto, akāsiṃ amaraṃ tapaṃ.

8798.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of na yoni, neg
8798.construction:
na > a + √yu > yo + *ni + so
ayoni + so

examples.text: ayoniso manasikārā, maṇḍanaṃ anuyuñjisaṃ, uddhato capalo c'āsiṃ, kāmarāgena aṭṭito.
ayoniso manasikāro kho, mahāli, hetu, ayoniso manasikāro paccayo pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyā.

8799.meaning1: radical inattention; not paying proper attention; imprudently applying the mind; unwise reflection; unfocused attention
8799.meaningLit: not making the source in mind
8799.commentary: (DNa) ayoniso manasikāro'ti anicce niccan'ti-ādinā nayena pavatto uppathamanasikāro.

examples.text: katamo eko dhammo hānabhāgiyo? ayoniso manasikāro. ayaṃ eko dhammo hānabhāgiyo.
ayoniso manasikārā, maṇḍanaṃ anuyuñjisaṃ, uddhato capalo c'āsiṃ, kāmarāgena aṭṭito.
